description: Allowed textual transforms when adapting the pinned @zag-js/react Vitest suite to Octane. verify-upstream.mjs applies the inverse of these before hashing adapted sources against the pristine originals.

transforms.summary: Allow a single leading `// Adapted from …` header on adapted files.
Allow `// Per tests/<file>:<line>` comments immediately above each adapted `test(...)`.
Allow explicit `vitest` named imports (`describe`/`expect`/`test`/`vi`) because the adapted Vitest project does not enable globals.
Allow Prettier/repo formatting drift: tabs vs spaces, single vs double quotes, and trailing semicolons. Blank-line-only differences are ignored for the hash.
